text:
𝟭𝟯𝟬 𝗢𝗣𝗘𝗡𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗦𝗧𝗔𝗡𝗗! 🇮🇳🔥

Jaiswal (85) and Rahul added 130 in Wellington, India's first 100-plus opening stand in NZ in 32 years.
India 159/1, trail by 209.

Can they take the lead? 👇

#INDvNZ #TeamIndia

𝗪𝗘𝗟𝗟𝗜𝗡𝗚𝗧𝗢𝗡 𝗠𝗘𝗜𝗡 𝗜𝗧𝗜𝗛𝗔𝗦! 🇮🇳🔥

👉 Jaiswal (85 off 89) aur Rahul ne pehle wicket ke liye 130 runs jode
👉 NZ mein 32 saal baad Indian openers ki 100+ partnership
👉 India 159/1, NZ ke 368 se 209 runs peeche

Kya India lead le payegi? Comment karo 👇
